mode_confirmation: Read is_beer_game_mode from sales.json.policy_context or blackboard.policy_context_by_department.sales. In beer_game mode, external market orders represent actual consumer demand.
conditions: analysis supports revenue growth or order fulfillment as a target.
Current inventory or available capacity can fulfill the order before its delivery deadline.
Accepting this order will not materially divert resources from existing commitments.
evaluation_points: Check whether stock is available for direct delivery.
If production is needed, check available production capacity.
Check for cascading pressure on production, procurement, or inventory.
If current stock is insufficient, check whether later procurement, production, or upstream delivery can still fulfill the order before delivery_deadline.
description_detail: After acceptance, fulfillment is due by the delivery date specified in the order.
parameter_constraints: When creating action.json, action_param must contain exactly the fields listed in required_parameters.
Do not duplicate order details such as product_id, quantity, unit_price, total_amount, source_id, or delivery_deadline in action_param.
